scripts.android:sync: npm run build:tablet && npm run cap:sync --workspace=apps/android-app
scripts.android:prep-db: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('apps/android-app/android/app/src/main/assets/databases', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('apps/pwa-app/public/assets/afiyet_med_knowledge.db', 'apps/android-app/android/app/src/main/assets/databases/afiyet_med_knowledge.db'); console.log('Vector database prepped inside APK assets.');"
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && npm run android:prep-db && node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); execSync('gradlew.bat assembleDebug', {cwd:'apps/android-app/android', stdio:'inherit', env:{...process.env, JAVA_HOME: process.env.JAVA_HOME || 'C:\\Program Files\\Android\\Android Studio\\jbr'}});"
scripts.android:push-model: npm run android:mkdir-models && node -e "const fs=require('fs'), {execSync}=require('child_process'); const llm=['packages/rag-builder/models/llm/medgemma-4b-it-Q4_K_M.gguf', 'packages/rag-builder/models/medgemma-4b-it-Q4_K_M.gguf'].find(fs.existsSync); const qemb=['packages/rag-builder/models/pre-embedding/ncbi/MedCPT-Query-Encoder/medcpt-query-encoder.onnx', 'packages/rag-builder/models/pre-embedding/ncbi/MedCPT-Query-Encoder/model.onnx'].find(fs.existsSync); if(llm){console.log('Pushing MedGemma LLM model:', llm); execSync(`adb push "${llm}" /sdcard/Afiyet/models/medgemma-4b-it.gguf`, {stdio:'inherit'});} else console.warn('MedGemma LLM model missing.'); if(qemb){console.log('Pushing MedCPT Query Encoder model:', qemb); execSync(`adb push "${qemb}" /sdcard/Afiyet/models/medcpt-query-encoder.onnx`, {stdio:'inherit'});} else console.warn('MedCPT Query Encoder ONNX model missing. Run npm run download-models first.');"
scripts.android:deploy: npm run android:build && npm run android:install

scripts-help.dev:tablet: START TABLET DEV SERVER: Launches local Vite development server for the clinical tablet PWA client.
scripts-help.dev:dashboard: START DASHBOARD DEV SERVER: Launches local Vite development server for the web admin dashboard.
scripts-help.dev:backend: START BACKEND DEV SERVER: Launches local Fastify backend with hot reload for CouchDB integration.
scripts-help.start:backend: RUN PRODUCTION BACKEND: Starts the production Fastify backend server.
scripts-help.build:tablet: BUILD TABLET PWA: Compiles Vite production bundle for the tablet PWA client.
scripts-help.build:dashboard: BUILD DASHBOARD PWA: Compiles Vite production bundle for the web admin dashboard.
scripts-help.test:pwa: RUN PWA TESTS: Executes Vitest test suite for offline PouchDB and clinical form components.
scripts-help.test:rag: RUN RAG TESTS: Evaluates medical retrieval precision and clinical schema validation.
scripts-help.install:all: INSTALL MONOREPO: Installs all npm dependencies across monorepo workspaces.
scripts-help.download-models: DOWNLOAD AI WEIGHTS: Downloads required MedCPT ONNX query encoder and MedGemma 4B GGUF model files from HuggingFace.
scripts-help.download-kb: DOWNLOAD KNOWLEDGE BASE: Fetches NIH MedlinePlus XML encyclopedia and Wikipedia medical guidelines.
scripts-help.download-medrag-full: DOWNLOAD FULL MEDRAG DATASETS: Downloads full 126k-chunk medical textbook dataset.
scripts-help.build-db: BUILD VECTOR DB: Compiles raw text into 768-dim MedCPT vectors and builds SQLite database afiyet_med_knowledge.db.
scripts-help.serve-ollama: SERVE MEDGEMMA MODEL WITH OLLAMA: Validates and serves local MedGemma GGUF model via Ollama for local PWA dev testing.
scripts-help.android:sync: SYNC CAPACITOR: Compiles tablet web app and syncs web assets into Capacitor Android project.
scripts-help.android:prep-db: PREPARE APK DATABASE: Copies afiyet_med_knowledge.db into Android assets/databases/ for uncompressed packaging.
scripts-help.android:build: BUILD APK ONLY: Compiles PWA UI, syncs Capacitor, embeds vector DB into APK assets, and runs Gradle build. Does NOT install to device.
scripts-help.android:install: FAST INSTALL ONLY: Takes an ALREADY COMPILED APK (app-debug.apk) and streams it directly to your phone/emulator over ADB without re-compiling.
scripts-help.android:mkdir-models: CREATE MODEL DIR: Creates /sdcard/Afiyet/models/ directory on Android phone via ADB.
scripts-help.android:push-model: PUSH MODELS TO PHONE: Pushes MedGemma LLM (2.48GB GGUF) and MedCPT Query Encoder (435MB ONNX) to phone storage /sdcard/Afiyet/models/ over ADB.
scripts-help.android:deploy: FULL END-TO-END WORKFLOW: Rebuilds Vite PWA, syncs Capacitor, packages SQLite database into APK assets, compiles debug APK with Gradle, and installs it onto connected phone/emulator via ADB.
scripts-help.android:open: OPEN IN ANDROID STUDIO: Opens the Capacitor Android project in Android Studio.
